idea-plugin.name: OpenProject Integration
idea-plugin.description:
Work with OpenProject work packages without leaving the IDE.

  • An OpenProject task server for Tools | Tasks & Contexts: open, switch and close work packages as tasks, and log time.
  • A work package table with configurable columns, sorting, search and filters.
  • A work package page with description, activity, relations and files.

Requires the Issue Trackers plugin. Configure the server in Settings | Tools | Tasks | Servers with an OpenProject API token.
